text_block_list.text:
"After finishing our errands, I was walking back
with Believe, who was returning to the academy, when—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! If it isn't Believe!
'Sup~ Whatcha up to?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'm about to head home.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, I gotcha. We were just killing time,
so we figured we'd hit up karaoke."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, you wanna come too, Believe? We're classmates, after all!
The fries there are seriously so good!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No.
I'm not going.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah? Well, it was out of the blue, after all. I'll invite you again if there's another chance.
Believe was being a bit blunt towards her friend. I began to worry whether people might misunderstand her personality.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's Believe-chan! I'm so happy
we could run into each other here! Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right. I'm actually meeting Pokke-chan and the others to eat out now, would you like to come?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No, thank you. I'll pass.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Really? I see~.
Well, maybe next time then!
The people around Believe are basically all good girls, so I think they understand her dry demeanor, but still...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Ah, it's Right O and the others...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I will slaughter you on this corner.
Taste thisâthe Raging Flames of Damocles!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kh, a fire item here of all places?!
Not bad, Durandal! Even though I totally crushed you just a moment ago!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You're the one who's going to get completely crushed next!
I'll push through just like this. Prepare to become rust upon my blade!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Hmph... But no matter how cornered I get, there's no way I'm drifting! I'll show you the terror of a wall-scraping corner turn!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Both of you.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: This is a public place. Please keep it down.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry!
I apologize.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Do you have free time after this too, Believe-san?
If so, care to spar with us?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"That's fine. —I've already inserted the coin.
Hurry up and take the 2P seat."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...No.
I'm good.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

Watching her behavior just now made me think that.
I knew what kind of girl she was, but can she really get through school life alright like this...?

And so, we returned to the academy.
A few hours after parting with Believe at the gate—

While walking through the central plaza, I noticed
Believe working on something with a trowel in hand.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I was asked to repair the pizza oven,
so I'm doing that."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"They said they needed to use it by tomorrow.
So somehow, before then..."

Hearing the deadline for the work, a thought suddenly strikes me.
Could it be—she turned down her friends' invitations
just to get this done?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It will take some time for the mortar to dry, as well.
Learning that Believe had her own principles behind her earlier actions brings relief. However—
Since she hadn't told her friends the "reason for refusing," she grew worried that a misunderstanding might have formed...
choice_data_list: You even turned down an invitation for this... Good on you!
You even turned down an invitation for this... That's admirable!
Are you okay? You're not pushing yourself too hard just to make it in time, are you?

text_block_list.text: Since she hadn't told her friends the "reason for refusing," she grew worried that a misunderstanding might have formed...
choice_data_list: You even turned down an invitation for this... Good on you!
You even turned down an invitation for this... That's admirable!
Are you okay? You're not pushing yourself too hard just to make it in time, are you?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...?
It's not particularly praiseworthy, really.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Because it's what I want to do.
choice_data_list: Still, it's admirable that you saw it through responsibly!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for concern.
I accepted the job knowing this deadline.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I judged that I was capable of doing it,
so I told them I would.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Now that you've said it, you have to do it.
